newsitem.title: SWEDEN: RESEARCH ALERT-Pharmacia & Upjohn estimates cut. [CORRECTED 17:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Pharmacia & Upjohn estimates cut. [CORRECTED 17:10 GMT]

text.p: Investment bank Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said on Thursday it had lowered its earnings per share forecast for U.S./Swedish drug group Pharmacia & Upjohn last week to $1.75 for 1997 and $2.00 for 1998.
(Corrects to make clear forecast made last week).
Analyst Steve Putnam said this was a cut of about 15 percent. The bank was keeping its hold recommendation on the stock.
"We have lowered our forecast for P&U as we are a bit worried about the results for the second quarter," Putnam told Reuters.
"We have kept a hold recommendation on the share but when we recommend Scandinavian shares to our clients we put (rival Swedish drug company) Astra before P&U."
P&U shares were 11 crowns down at 260 crowns at 1440 GMT.
